threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still wait for the 149 bus and look shocked when it’s late. Everyone’s already used to the chaos of the timetable.
Last night on the 133, I watched a couple argue about whether pineapple belongs on pizza. It got loud enough for the driver to turn around and smirk.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Caught a guy on my block feeding stray cats while blasting old Klaus Kinski movies. That’s when it hit me—this place has a vibe you just can’t fake.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Every Saturday in Kreuzberg, the Turkish market transforms the canal into a vibrant bazaar; the scents of grilled köfte and spices are unreal!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell who’s from here; they shrug off BART chaos while others panic at the train delays, like it's just Tuesday.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Just saw a guy serenade the 38 bus with a ukulele. Crowded but everyone stopped to listen, even the driver. Classic San Francisco moment.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all about the fancy plazas; they miss the quiet corners where the old residents still sip coffee and gossip about the weather.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their struggle to figure out the difference between 'carrer' and 'via'. Watch them hesitate at street signs.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think the bus will take you anywhere on a Sunday. Just wait till you miss brunch plans because of the one-hour gap.
Last night on the 35, a bloke serenaded the whole bus with a piano cover of 'Wonderwall'—half the passengers joined in. Only in Brixton.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I dodged a rickety bike while tripping over a stray cat and caught the scent of döners mixing with fresh coffee in the air.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a taco truck parked beside a doner kebab stand, both serving their late-night crowds with equal fervor.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local when they know the bus delays by heart, skipping the BART station just to avoid the crowd and chaos.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy on the 14 bus doing an elaborate puppet show with his backpack. No one even batted an eye; just another day in the Mission.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think Gràcia is all about Gaudí; they miss the hidden plaça with local art and the best vermut at that tiny bar on Carrer de Peratallada.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their intense fascination with the Gràcia squares, taking selfies while locals just grab a drink and head in to escape the heat.
